home.heroTitle: Turn any JS function into a tool your AI can call
home.heroSubtitle: Write a short JavaScript function, izan.io turns it into an MCP tool. Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code - any MCP client calls it and gets the result. 500+ community tools included, or write your own in minutes.
home.problemTitle: AI wastes time figuring out browsers
home.problemDesc: Ask an AI to check your Amazon orders and watch it struggle. It guesses selectors, gets lost in popups, retries five times, and still fails. So you look for an API - if one even exists, it costs money, needs an API key, has rate limits, and returns half the data you actually need. Meanwhile the data is right there on the screen. You just need a 20-line JS tool to grab it. izan.io lets you write that tool once and call it forever.
home.step1Desc: Get izan.io from the Chrome Web Store. One click, no config. The extension runs an MCP server inside your browser.
home.step2Title: Add one line to your AI tool
home.step2Desc: Add the config below to Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, or any MCP client. The bridge starts automatically.
home.step3Desc: Your AI calls pre-built tools like amazon_search or gmail_read_inbox. Each tool knows exactly what to do - no page inspection, no guessing selectors. Fast, reliable, back-to-back.
home.configTitle: Claude Desktop / Claude Code / Cursor / VS Code
home.feature1Desc: Tools handle all the browser logic - clicking, waiting, scrolling, extracting. The AI just calls a function and gets structured data back. No wasted tokens figuring out selectors.
home.feature2Desc: Amazon, Gmail, LinkedIn, GitHub, YouTube and 80+ more sites covered. Install from the marketplace, or write your own with the built-in editor.
home.feature3Desc: Tools run inside your real browser. No separate Chrome instance, no cookie hacks. If you are logged in, the tools can access it.
home.feature4Desc: AGPL-3.0 licensed. Fully transparent. No vendor lock-in. Self-host or contribute.
home.marketplaceDesc: Amazon, Gmail, LinkedIn, Jira, YouTube, GitHub - browse and install community-created tools. One click from the extension side panel.
home.footer: © 2026 izan.io - Open source browser automation for AI
